messages:
Anya P.: Heads up — recurring asks from multiple mid-market accounts. Top three themes: 1) per-route cost breakdown in the Console (customers want per-endpoint billing), 2) gaps in Dedicated onboarding docs around subnet/KMS/network examples, 3) private deployment networking examples (VPC peering, firewall rules).

Michael C.: Can you list which accounts + one-sentence quotes? Need to decide fast-track vs backlog.

Anya P.: Brightlane (mid-market) — 'We can't forecast charges per feature; engineering can't justify renewal without it.'
Parkly (startup) — 'Onboarding docs for Dedicated didn't show exact subnet/CIDR we needed.'
Acme Retail (trial) — 'We need VPC peering + firewall examples for our security review.'

Rajiv S.: Renewal at Brightlane in ~6 weeks. This was the main objection on the last call. If we don't have a mitigation (doc or export) we risk slipping renewal.

Jenna O.: Drafting a capture template now — putting an example CSV below so we can standardize how CS submits asks to product.

```csv
customer,account_tier,ask_type,frequency,impact,suggested_priority,notes
Brightlane,Mid-market,Per-route-cost,weekly,renewal_risk,high,"Wants per-endpoint chargeback for feature X"
Parkly,Startup,Dedicated-onboard,once,enablement,medium,"subnet/CIDR examples missing"
Acme Retail,Enterprise,Private-networking,occasional,security,high,"needs VPC peering example + firewall rules"
```

Anya P.: Also hearing requests for a Console "export per-route usage" toggle — quick win?

Michael C.: Proposed short-term plan: 1) CS playbook snippet for renewals to explain current billing granularity, 2) quick docs + sample CSV to share with customers, 3) product spike to estimate engineering effort. If PM votes yes I'll put this on next sprint planning. @Jenna O. can you own the sample doc?

Jenna O.: Yes — I'll draft the Dedicated onboarding doc + sample CSV. AWS first, ETA EOD Thu. Will include a minimal networking checklist (CIDR, security groups, KMS key rotation notes).

Sam Q.: Product/Eng side: I'll open a ticket tagged `cs-urgent` and link this thread. Recommend a lightweight spike to measure complexity of per-route metering and CSV export. If spike is <2d we can plan an MVP for next sprint.

cs-bot: Poll created: "Priority for per-route cost export" — results so far: 6 votes high, 1 medium.

Rajiv S.: I'll call Brightlane this week and offer the sample CSV + a short walk-through. Also will note that a product change is being investigated (should calm them).

Anya P.: :thumbsup: Please add these rows to the CS Feedback Notion table so we have a single source of truth. Link: https://notion.redwood/cs-feedback (placeholder).

Michael C.: I'll own the triage session Friday 11am. Action items: Sam Q. create ticket, Jenna O. draft doc, Rajiv S. customer bridge call, Anya P. populate Notion rows.

Jenna O.: Quick Q: for Dedicated onboarding examples customers are asking for both AWS and GCP. I’ll do AWS first then GCP follow-up.

Anya P.: Noted. If anyone hears more quotes please drop them below — even one-line items help prioritize.

Sam Q.: Ticket created: RW-4382 (`cs-urgent/per-route-export`). Linked this thread and attached Jenna's CSV example.

Rajiv S.: Bumping — Brightlane renewal call scheduled Mon. Will provide sample CSV and ask for an intro to their finance lead.

Michael C.: Thanks all — we'll use Friday triage to set priority for roadmap. :eyes:

Anya P.: Thanks team.
